entities.name: Barrin Grevik
entities.description: A self-satisfied Ravnican market shopkeeper on Tin Street, from a long line of market people, who follows a stranger he suspects of being a Dimir.

entities.name: Nila
entities.description: Barrin's wife, who defends the Dimir against street rumors and calls her in-laws the dromads.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mage in a hooded blue cloak who is searching for Azorius waypoints along the Implicit Maze and erases Barrin's memory.

entities.name: Estovar
entities.description: Barrin's great uncle, whose theory was that the cornerstone was placed by the Azorius after the first Guildpact.

entities.name: Old Scrumpy
entities.description: A tavern regular used as a byword for blathering, and the person Nila assumes Barrin was drinking with.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed by guilds, where the story takes place.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A market street in Ravnica's Tenth District where the Grevik family has run the same shop spot for generations.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The Ravnican district shown in Jace's glowing map, containing Tin Street.

entities.name: The cornerstone
entities.description: An old etched stone by Barrin's shop that is actually an Azorius waypoint along the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A series of ancient clues left by Azorius guildmages, whose function and power Jace does not fully understand but which he must run in the right sequence.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild of law that left the waypoints and kept the legislative archives.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild blamed by Tin Street for everything that goes wrong; Jace says they are forcing his hand.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: The guild whose wojek enforcers supplied Barrin's pendrek.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild whose goblin ambushes Barrin in the alley.

entities.name: Rakdos goblin
entities.description: A goblin with filed teeth who jumps out at Barrin in the alley and flees when he brandishes his pendrek.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact that bound the guilds; Estovar claims the Azorius placed the stone soon after its signing.

entities.name: Azorius legislative archives
entities.description: A tall tower to which Jace's map leads from Tin Street.

entities.name: Pendrek
entities.description: An old Boros stun weapon with a few mana charges, a gift from Barrin's wojek friend.

events.summary: Barrin notices a hooded stranger taking interest in the cornerstone by his shop.
events.quote: Barrin Grevik wondered why that strange man in the hooded cloak had taken such an interest in the cornerstone

events.summary: The stranger asks about the stone and Barrin, compelled, tells him its entire known history including Estovar's theory.
events.quote: He felt compelled to leave nothing out

events.summary: Barrin, convinced the stranger is a Dimir, resolves to follow him despite Nila's objections.
events.quote: "He's a Dimir, Nila. I just know it."

events.summary: Barrin follows the hooded man into a dark alley and chases off a Rakdos goblin with his pendrek.
events.quote: Barrin brandished his pendrek and the goblin scampered off into the dark, cackling obscenities.

events.summary: Barrin finds the stranger in a basement studying a glowing map of the Tenth District that traces lines from Tin Street to the Azorius archives.
events.quote: He slowly opened it to reveal the hooded stranger staring at a ghostlike image of the Tenth District

events.summary: Jace explains that the cornerstone is an Azorius waypoint on the Implicit Maze and that he must find them all.
events.quote: The cornerstone by your shop is actually an Azorius waypoint, an ancient series of clues left by the Azorius guildmages.

events.summary: Jace reveals he is not a Dimir and warns that the guilds will destroy one another unless he runs the maze in the right sequence.
events.quote: The other guilds are going to destroy one another unless I can run the maze in the right sequence.

events.summary: Jace gives his name and wipes Barrin's memory of the encounter.
events.quote: And you are not going to remember a single moment of this, my foolish friend.

events.summary: Barrin wakes with no memory and blames drinking bumbat.

relations.quote: His wife, Nila, noticed that Barrin had "that look" in his eyes
Barrin even told the man about his great uncle Estovar's theory

relations.note: Jace says the Dimir are forcing his hand to act fast.
relations.quote: the Dimir are forcing my hand to act fast.

relations.note: Its waypoints were left by Azorius guildmages.
relations.quote: They are points along the Implicit Maze, and I have to find all of them.

relations.note: The cornerstone is one of the maze's waypoints.
relations.quote: The cornerstone by your shop is actually an Azorius waypoint
